product.name: Monoprice 3-piece Desktop for Motorized and Manual-Crank Height Adjustable Desks Black
product.description: These desktops can be used to complete Monoprice™ electric motorized and manual crank sit‑stand desk frames. Get a full work surface that effortlessly moves up or down with your height adjustable desk. There is enough room for a computer, monitors, a keyboard, a mouse, and other desk essentials. Two color options are available to match your desk frame. Pre‑drilled holes make it easy to position and mount the desktop.These desktops ship in three main pieces in a manageable box that is practical to ship and carry indoors. It is easy to assemble, with two steel bars providing structural support and rigidity. The desktops are designed for computer use and made from engineered wood. There are no soft or hollow spots on these desktops, so they can support mounts and computer components. Grommet holes provide wire management options for maintaining a neat and tidy work area. The ergonomic shape allows you to move in closer towards the middle, while staying within easy reach of the sides.Features: This desktop can be mounted on Monoprice™ Sit‑Stand Desk FramesEasy to ship and handleErgonomic designDesigned for computer useThe desktop comes in three main pieces and is delivered in a manageable box that is more practical to ship and easier to bring indoors, upstairs, or inside rooms than a full sized desktopThe desk shape allows you to move in closer towards the middle, while staying within easy reach of the sidesMade of engineered wood, with no soft or hollow spots, which allows you to use mounting screws on any part of the desktopShipping Box Dimensions: 37.5" x 27.0" x 3.0"Shipping Box Weight: 42 lbs.Assembled Dimensions: 31.5" x 63.0" x 1.6"SIT-STAND DESK FRAME OPTIONSThis desktop is designed to be mounted onto Sit-Stand desk frames, allowing you to choose from a range of Worksteam™ Sit-Stand desk frames. Simply drill mounting holes into the desktop and secure it in place with screws.
